newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares surge to record levels in bourse.
newsitem.headline: German shares surge to record levels in bourse.

text.p: Germany's DAX index showed no signs of giving up momentum on Wednesday as the blue-chip index set its sights on breaking 4,200 points.
The 30-share DAX index was up 69.78 points at 4,190.91 points, while the IBIS DAX, which reflects all-day computer dealings, was up 52.58 points at 4,192.26 points.
"The buy orders are coming into the market without end," said one Frankfurt dealer. "It's the same thing every day. There are no sell orders, only buyers from a broad spectrum."
Dealers said the DAX was targeting 4,200 points ahead of Friday's expiry of DAX futures options.
One trader said open interest at the 4,200 strike was "very strong" and that the level was "acting like a magnet" in drawing the market to new record highs.
The DAX's upward trend was constantly setting new all-time record highs, which reached a peak at 4,197.15 in the IBIS DAX.
The usual factors -- a firmer dollar and Wall Street gains -- were the driving forces behind the German market's advance.
"I'd give this market an 80 percent chance of ending the week above 4,200 points," said one dealer. "It's hard to keep justifying these levels but it's still a good bull market."
Export-sensitive shares in the DAX index continued to be strong performers, particularly chemical shares.
Hoechst AG was up 2.05 marks at 83.45 marks after setting a new record high at 84 marks in IBIS trade, while Bayer AG rose 1.58 marks to 75.58 marks and BASF AG rose 1.80 marks to 70.20 marks.
Lufthansa AG shook off early losses to gain 15 pfennigs to 35.30 marks, boosted by news on Tuesday that the airline said it was in talks to sell its 25 percent stake in airline Cargolux to Swissair.

Karstadt AG was among the best performers, rising 33.50 marks to 659 marks despite market speculation that the retailer will soon be dropped from the DAX index in favour of sportswear group Adidas AG.
Adidas shares were up 90 pfennigs at 226 marks.
